<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">

<style data-no-optimize="1" data-no-defer="1" data-no-minify="1">

/* WordPress wrapper: reset theme and Elementor kit styles inside the page */
html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; background: #fffaf2; }
body { overflow-x: hidden; }
#ght *, #ght *::before, #ght *::after { all: revert; }
#ght { display: block; min-height: 100vh; }
#ght {
  color-scheme: light;
  
  --bg: #fffaf2;          
  --surface: var(--bg);   
  --white: #ffffff;
  --aqua-light: #dcf2f4;  
  --sun-light: #fff1c6;   
  --ink: #16222c;         
  --muted: #5a6872;       
  --line: #e6dccb;        
  --aqua: #18a4b6;        
  --aqua-deep: #0d7786;   
  --sun: #ffb703;         
  --sun-hover: #ffc633;
  --coral: #ff6a45;       
  --orange: #ff7a1a;      
  --black: #121212;       
  --on-black: #ffffff;
  --paper: #ffffff;       
  --paper-ink: #16222c;
  
  --display: "Shrikhand", "Cooper Black", "Arial Rounded MT Bold", Georgia, serif;
  --body: "Hanken Grotesk", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  
  --t-xs: 0.8125rem;
  --t-sm: 0.9375rem;
  --t-md: 1.125rem;
  --t-lg: 1.3125rem;
  --t-xl: clamp(1.9rem, 3.4vw, 2.7rem);
  --t-2xl: clamp(2.3rem, 4.8vw, 3.9rem);
  --gutter-l: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px));
  --gutter-r: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px));
  --radius: 14px;
  --radius-sm: 10px;
  --shadow-hard: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink);
  --shadow-soft: 0 14px 34px -22px rgba(22, 34, 44, 0.35);
}
#ght * { box-sizing: border-box; }
#ght [hidden] { display: none !important; }
html { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; scroll-behavior: smooth; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
#ght * { transition: none !important; }
#ght .burst { animation: none; }
}
#ght {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--body);
  font-size: var(--t-md);
  line-height: 1.55;
  overflow-x: clip;
}
#ght img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
#ght a { color: var(--aqua-deep); }
#ght h1, #ght h2, #ght h3, #ght h4 { margin: 0; text-wrap: balance; }
#ght p { margin: 0; }
#ght button { font: inherit; }
#ght :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--aqua); outline-offset: 3px; }
#ght .wrap {
  max-width: 1120px;
  margin-inline: auto;
  padding-left: var(--gutter-l);
  padding-right: var(--gutter-r);
}
#ght .band { padding-block: clamp(56px, 8vw, 104px); }
#ght .band + .band { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
#ght .band-aqua { background: var(--aqua-light); --surface: var(--aqua-light); border-top: 0 !important; }
#ght .band-sun { background: var(--sun-light); --surface: var(--sun-light); border-top: 0 !important; }
#ght .band-aqua + .band, #ght .band-sun + .band { border-top: 0; }
#ght .eyebrow {
  font-family: var(--body);
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: var(--t-xs);
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--aqua-deep);
}
#ght .h-display {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1.02;
  font-size: var(--t-2xl);
}
#ght .h-section {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1.05;
  font-size: var(--t-xl);
}
#ght .h-sub { font-family: var(--body); font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.35rem; line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
#ght .lede { font-size: var(--t-lg); line-height: 1.45; max-width: 36rem; }
#ght .muted { color: var(--muted); }
#ght .measure { max-width: 38rem; }
#ght .ital { font-style: italic; }
#ght .label {
  font-family: var(--body); font-weight: 700; font-size: var(--t-xs);
  letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted);
}
#ght .btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.6em;
  min-height: 58px;
  padding: 0.7em 1.5em;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border: 2px solid var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--body);
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: 1.125rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.005em;
  text-decoration: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  line-height: 1.1;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--white);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-hard);
  transition: transform 120ms ease, box-shadow 120ms ease, background-color 120ms ease;
}
#ght .btn:hover { transform: translate(-1px, -1px); box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 var(--ink); }
#ght .btn:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--ink); }
#ght .btn-gold { background: var(--sun); }
#ght .btn-gold:hover { background: var(--sun-hover); }
#ght .btn-ghost { background: var(--white); }
#ght .btn-paper { background: var(--ink); color: var(--white); }
#ght .btn-paper:hover { background: #22323f; }
#ght .btn-block { width: 100%; }
#ght .btn-sm { min-height: 44px; font-size: 1rem; padding: 0.45em 1em; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink); }
#ght .btn-sm:hover { box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink); }
#ght .btn .arrow { font-weight: 800; }
#ght .cta-note { font-size: var(--t-sm); color: var(--muted); margin-top: 12px; }
#ght .topbar {
  position: sticky;
  top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
  z-index: 20;
  background: var(--black);
  color: var(--on-black);
}
#ght .topbar .wrap {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  min-height: 66px;
}
#ght .brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; text-decoration: none; color: var(--on-black); }
#ght .brand img { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; }
#ght .brand .name { font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.2rem; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; }
#ght .brand .name small { display: block; font-family: var(--body); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.68rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--sun); margin-top: 5px; }
#ght .topbar .phone { font-weight: 600; font-size: var(--t-sm); color: var(--on-black); text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; }
#ght .topbar .phone b { color: var(--sun); font-weight: 800; }
#ght .topbar .actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; }
#ght .topbar .btn-sm { border-color: var(--sun); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--sun); }
#ght .topbar .btn-sm:hover { box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--sun); }
@media (max-width: 720px) {
#ght .topbar .btn-sm { display: none; }
}
@media (max-width: 520px) {
#ght .topbar .wrap { gap: 8px; }
#ght .brand { gap: 8px; }
#ght .brand img { width: 36px; height: 36px; }
#ght .brand .name { font-size: 0.95rem; }
#ght .brand .name small { display: none; }
#ght .topbar .phone { font-size: 0.78rem; }
#ght .mobilebar .btn { font-size: 1rem; }
}
#ght .hero {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding-block: clamp(40px, 7vw, 96px) clamp(40px, 6vw, 72px);
}
#ght .hero-bg {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1;
  background-image: url("https://generationhottubs.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Product-Classic-BG-1.webp");
  background-size: cover;
  background-position: center;
  opacity: 0.9;
  -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 38%, #000 80%);
  mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 38%, #000 80%);
}
#ght .hero-bg::after {
  content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,250,242,0.1), rgba(255,250,242,0.55));
}
@media (max-width: 880px) {
#ght .hero-bg { -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 55%, #000 100%); mask-image: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 55%, #000 100%); }
}
#ght .bubbles { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; pointer-events: none; overflow: hidden; }
#ght .bubbles i {
  position: absolute; border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, rgba(255,255,255,0.9), rgba(24,164,182,0.18) 60%, rgba(24,164,182,0.05));
  border: 1px solid rgba(24,164,182,0.25);
}
#ght .bubbles i:nth-child(1) { width: 140px; height: 140px; left: 52%; top: 8%; }
#ght .bubbles i:nth-child(2) { width: 54px; height: 54px; left: 63%; top: 34%; }
#ght .bubbles i:nth-child(3) { width: 90px; height: 90px; left: 70%; top: 58%; }
#ght .bubbles i:nth-child(4) { width: 32px; height: 32px; left: 58%; top: 70%; }
@media (max-width: 880px) {
#ght .bubbles i:nth-child(1) { left: 72%; top: 4%; width: 90px; height: 90px; }
#ght .bubbles i:nth-child(2) { left: 88%; top: 20%; }
#ght .bubbles i:nth-child(3), #ght .bubbles i:nth-child(4) { display: none; }
}
#ght .hero-grid { display: grid; gap: 28px; }
#ght .dates { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: clamp(8px, 2.5vw, 28px); margin-top: 6px; }
#ght .dates .mon {
  font-family: var(--body);
  font-weight: 800;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 3vw, 1.8rem);
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  color: var(--aqua-deep);
  writing-mode: vertical-rl;
  transform: rotate(180deg);
  line-height: 1;
  padding-bottom: 10px;
}
#ght .dates .d { display: grid; justify-items: start; }
#ght .dates .num {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-weight: 400;
  font-size: clamp(6rem, 21vw, 14rem);
  line-height: 0.9;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  padding-right: 0.08em;
}
#ght .dates .dow {
  font-family: var(--body);
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: var(--t-xs);
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--aqua-deep);
  margin-top: 8px;
}
#ght .dates .sep { font-family: var(--display); font-size: clamp(3rem, 10vw, 7rem); color: var(--sun); line-height: 0.9; padding-bottom: 0.75em; -webkit-text-stroke: 1px var(--ink); }
#ght .hero-copy { display: grid; gap: 18px; max-width: 44rem; }
#ght .hero-grid { grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-areas: "eyebrow eyebrow" "dates burst" "copy copy"; }
#ght .hero-grid > .eyebrow { grid-area: eyebrow; }
#ght .hero-grid > .dates { grid-area: dates; }
#ght .hero-grid > .hero-copy { grid-area: copy; }
#ght .burst {
  --burst: polygon(50.0% 0.0%, 56.4% 9.5%, 65.5% 2.4%, 68.6% 13.5%, 79.4% 9.5%, 79.0% 21.0%, 90.5% 20.6%, 86.5% 31.4%, 97.6% 34.5%, 90.5% 43.6%, 100.0% 50.0%, 90.5% 56.4%, 97.6% 65.5%, 86.5% 68.6%, 90.5% 79.4%, 79.0% 79.0%, 79.4% 90.5%, 68.6% 86.5%, 65.5% 97.6%, 56.4% 90.5%, 50.0% 100.0%, 43.6% 90.5%, 34.5% 97.6%, 31.4% 86.5%, 20.6% 90.5%, 21.0% 79.0%, 9.5% 79.4%, 13.5% 68.6%, 2.4% 65.5%, 9.5% 56.4%, 0.0% 50.0%, 9.5% 43.6%, 2.4% 34.5%, 13.5% 31.4%, 9.5% 20.6%, 21.0% 21.0%, 20.6% 9.5%, 31.4% 13.5%, 34.5% 2.4%, 43.6% 9.5%);
  grid-area: burst; align-self: center; justify-self: start;
  margin-left: clamp(24px, 5vw, 72px);
  position: relative; isolation: isolate;
  width: clamp(150px, 19vw, 220px); aspect-ratio: 1;
  display: grid; place-content: center; justify-items: center; text-align: center;
  color: var(--ink); line-height: 1;
  transform: rotate(-9deg);
  filter: drop-shadow(6px 6px 0 var(--aqua));
  animation: burst-in 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.2, 1.4, 0.4, 1) 0.2s both;
}
#ght .burst::before, #ght .burst::after { content: ""; position: absolute; clip-path: var(--burst); z-index: -1; }
#ght .burst::before { inset: -3px; background: var(--ink); }
#ght .burst::after { inset: 0; background: radial-gradient(circle at 40% 35%, #ffa04d, var(--orange) 70%); }
#ght .burst .pre, #ght .burst .post { font-family: var(--body); font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.3vw, 1rem); }
#ght .burst .big { font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 400; font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 5.2vw, 4.1rem); line-height: 0.95; margin: 2px 0 0; }
#ght .burst .post { font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: none; font-size: clamp(1.3rem, 2.4vw, 1.9rem); line-height: 0.9; }
@keyframes burst-in { from { transform: rotate(-40deg) scale(0.4); opacity: 0; } to { transform: rotate(-9deg) scale(1); opacity: 1; } }
@media (max-width: 880px) {
#ght .hero-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; grid-template-areas: "eyebrow burst" "dates dates" "copy copy"; }
#ght .hero-grid > .eyebrow { align-self: center; }
#ght .burst { margin: -10px 4px -18px 8px; width: 118px; }
#ght .burst .pre { font-size: 0.66rem; }
#ght .burst .big { font-size: 2.15rem; }
#ght .burst .post { font-size: 1.05rem; }
#ght .bubbles i:nth-child(1), #ght .bubbles i:nth-child(2) { display: none; }
}
#ght .cta-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; align-items: center; }
#ght .trust {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px 26px;
  margin-top: 14px; padding-top: 18px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  font-weight: 700; font-size: var(--t-xs); letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted);
}
#ght .trust a { color: inherit; text-decoration-color: var(--aqua); text-underline-offset: 3px; }
#ght .trust span::before { content: ""; display: inline-block; width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--aqua); margin-right: 9px; vertical-align: 0; }
#ght .count { background: var(--sun); color: var(--ink); border-top: 2px solid var(--ink); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink); }
#ght .count .wrap {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 10px 24px; min-height: 66px; padding-block: 12px;
  font-weight: 800; font-size: var(--t-sm); letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase;
}
#ght .count .timer { display: flex; gap: 18px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
#ght .count .timer b { font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.9rem; line-height: 1; margin-right: 6px; }
#ght .sec-head { display: grid; gap: 14px; margin-bottom: clamp(28px, 4vw, 48px); max-width: 48rem; }
#ght .benefits { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 16px; }
#ght .benefit { background: var(--white); border: 2px solid var(--ink); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 22px 22px 24px; display: grid; gap: 10px; align-content: start; min-width: 0; box-shadow: var(--shadow-hard); }
#ght .benefit .k { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--aqua); color: var(--white); display: grid; place-items: center; font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.85rem; }
#ght .benefit h3 { font-family: var(--body); font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.3rem; line-height: 1.15; }
@media (max-width: 760px) {
#ght .benefits { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
#ght .offer-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.1fr) minmax(0, 0.9fr); gap: clamp(28px, 5vw, 64px); align-items: center; }
@media (max-width: 880px) {
#ght .offer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
#ght .ticket {
  --notch: 18px;
  position: relative;
  background: var(--paper);
  color: var(--paper-ink);
  max-width: 460px;
  width: 100%;
  margin-inline: auto;
  border: 2px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 var(--ink);
  transform: rotate(-1.5deg);
}
#ght .ticket.flat { transform: none; }
#ght .ticket::before, #ght .ticket::after {
  content: ""; position: absolute; left: calc(var(--notch) * -0.5 - 2px); width: var(--notch); height: var(--notch);
  background: var(--surface); border: 2px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 50%; top: calc(72% - var(--notch) / 2);
  clip-path: inset(0 0 0 50%);
}
#ght .ticket::after { left: auto; right: calc(var(--notch) * -0.5 - 2px); clip-path: inset(0 50% 0 0); }
#ght .ticket .t-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 16px 22px 14px; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink); background: var(--aqua-light); border-radius: 12px 12px 0 0; }
#ght .ticket .t-head img { width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 50%; }
#ght .ticket .t-head .lbl { font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.68rem; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--aqua-deep); }
#ght .ticket .t-head .lbl b { display: block; font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.5rem; letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: none; color: var(--paper-ink); margin-top: 2px; }
#ght .ticket .t-body { padding: 18px 22px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 14px 18px; }
#ght .ticket .f { display: grid; gap: 3px; min-width: 0; }
#ght .ticket .f .l { font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.66rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
#ght .ticket .f .v { font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.35rem; line-height: 1.1; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
#ght .ticket .f .v.sm { font-family: var(--body); font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.35; }
#ght .ticket .f.wide { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
#ght .ticket .t-foot { border-top: 2px dashed var(--ink); padding: 14px 22px 18px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; }
#ght .ticket .stamp {
  font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 400; font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: none;
  color: var(--coral); border: 2px solid var(--coral); padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 8px; transform: rotate(-6deg);
}
#ght .ticket .barcode { height: 34px; flex: 1; max-width: 140px;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ink) 0 2px, transparent 2px 4px, var(--ink) 4px 5px, transparent 5px 8px, var(--ink) 8px 11px, transparent 11px 13px);
  opacity: 0.85; }
#ght .split { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: clamp(28px, 5vw, 72px); align-items: center; }
@media (max-width: 880px) {
#ght .split { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
#ght .photo { position: relative; transform: rotate(1.2deg); }
#ght .photo img { width: 100%; border: 2px solid var(--ink); border-radius: var(--radius); box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 var(--aqua); }
#ght .photo .cap { position: absolute; left: 14px; bottom: -14px; background: var(--sun); color: var(--ink); font-weight: 800; font-size: var(--t-xs); letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 8px 14px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 999px; transform: rotate(-2deg); }
#ght .points { display: grid; gap: 18px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
#ght .points li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 34px 1fr; gap: 14px; align-items: start; }
#ght .points li .mark { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--sun); border: 2px solid var(--ink); display: grid; place-items: center; font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--ink); }
#ght .points li b { display: block; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.2rem; line-height: 1.15; margin-bottom: 4px; }
#ght .lineup { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 20px; }
@media (max-width: 880px) {
#ght .lineup { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
#ght .tub { background: var(--white); border: 2px solid var(--ink); border-radius: var(--radius); display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto 1fr; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft); transition: transform 150ms ease; }
#ght .tub:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); }
#ght .tub .shot { background: var(--aqua-light); aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; max-width: 100%; display: grid; place-items: center; overflow: hidden; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink); }
#ght .tub .shot img { width: 72%; height: auto; mix-blend-mode: multiply; }
#ght .tub .body { padding: 20px 22px 24px; display: grid; gap: 10px; align-content: start; }

      <div class="lineup-foot">
        <p>Also on the floor: the Classic Series GH500 and GH550, and the GH 10000 to GH 16000 swim spas.</p>
        <a class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" href="/factory-sale/quiz/">Which one is mine? <span class="arrow">&rarr;</span></a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- QUOTES -->
  <section class="band band-aqua" id="owners">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="sec-head">
        <p class="eyebrow">From Generation owners</p>
      </div>
      <div class="quotes">
        <figure class="quote">
          <p>&ldquo;Generation Hot Tubs turned my backyard into an oasis of relaxation. I can't thank them enough for the serenity they've brought into my life.&rdquo;</p>
          <cite>Sarah Emily</cite>
        </figure>
        <figure class="quote">
          <p>&ldquo;The quality of my Generation Hot Tub is unparalleled. It's not just a purchase; it's a lifestyle upgrade.&rdquo;</p>
          <cite>David Williams</cite>
        </figure>
        <figure class="quote">
          <p>&ldquo;Generation Hot Tubs has exceeded my expectations. The therapeutic benefits and durability of their products are truly exceptional.&rdquo;</p>
          <cite>Sophia Jackson</cite>
        </figure>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- FOUNDER -->
  <section class="band" id="founder">
    <div class="wrap founder">
      <img src="https://generationhottubs.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Generation-Hot-Tub-Logo-Circle.png" alt="">
      <div>
        <blockquote>&ldquo;I believe that family and friends should have a place to come and be together because life is too short and too busy to miss those opportunities. Some of our family's favorite memories are those in our home and in our backyard. Here's to creating a legacy of leisure!&rdquo;</blockquote>
        <p class="who"><b>Kevin Sparks</b> &middot; Owner and founder, Generation Hot Tubs</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- EVENT DETAILS -->
  <section class="band" id="details">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="sec-head">
        <p class="eyebrow">Plan your visit</p>
        <h2 class="h-section">Three days. One address.</h2>
      </div>
      <div class="details">
        <div>
          <div class="sched" data-ght-hours></div>
          <div class="addr">
            <span class="big">300 Garfield Street</span>
            <span>McMinnville, TN 37110</span>
            <span><a data-ght-href="mapsUrl" href="https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=300+Garfield+Street+McMinnville+TN+37110" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Get directions &rarr;</a></span>
            <span>Questions: <a data-ght-href="phoneHref" href="tel:+19314142908" data-ght="phone">931-414-2908</a></span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <h3 class="h-section" style="font-size:1.6rem;margin-bottom:18px">What to expect</h3>
          <ul class="expect">
            <li>Every current model on the floor, with the sale price on it.</li>
            <li>Sit in them, dry. Check the seat depth, the jet placement and the footprint against your space.</li>
            <li>A financing desk on site for applications, or apply ahead online.</li>
            <li>Delivery scheduling at the time of purchase.</li>
            <li>The people who build these tubs, answering questions all three days.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>

  <!-- FINANCING (GreenSky) -->
  <section class="band" id="financing">
    <div class="wrap fin-row">
      <div class="sec-head" style="margin-bottom:0">
        <p class="eyebrow">Paying over time</p>
        <h2 class="h-section">Get approved before you come.</h2>
        <p class="lede muted">Generation offers special financing through GreenSky. The application takes about five minutes online, so on sale day you are picking a tub, not filling out forms.</p>
        <p class="muted">Subject to credit approval. Plan terms are in the GreenSky box. Rather apply in person? There is a financing desk at the sale all three days.</p>
        <div class="cta-row" style="margin-top:6px">
          <a class="btn btn-gold" href="/factory-sale/quiz/">Claim my Factory Pass too <span class="arrow">&rarr;</span></a>
        </div>
      </div>

  <!-- FAQ -->
  <section class="band" id="faq">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="sec-head">
        <p class="eyebrow">Good questions</p>
      </div>
      <div class="faq">
        <details>
          <summary>Do I need a Factory Pass to come?</summary>
          <div class="a">No. The sale is open to the public. The pass gets you the price sheet a day early, first call on floor models and a head start on financing. It is free.</div>
        </details>
        <details>
          <summary>How does the financing work?</summary>
          <div class="a">Financing is through GreenSky, subject to credit approval. The sale plan is a 12-month promotion: interest accrues from the date of purchase and is waived only if you pay the full amount within 12 months. If you do not, that interest is charged. Full terms are in the GreenSky box above. Apply online before the sale, or at the financing desk during the event.</div>
        </details>
        <details>
          <summary>What is the warranty?</summary>
          <div class="a">Ten years on the shell structure, three years on the acrylic surface, plumbing and electrical equipment, and one year on the cabinet and auxiliary components. Full terms are at generationhottubs.com/warranty.</div>
        </details>
        <details>
          <summary>Can I get the sale price before November 5?</summary>
          <div class="a">Sale pricing is only honored at the event, November 5 through 7. Pass holders see the prices a day early so they can plan, but the buying happens at the factory.</div>
        </details>
        <details>
          <summary>What about delivery?</summary>
          <div class="a">Delivery and placement are scheduled when you buy. Bring a photo of where the tub will go and the team will tell you what it takes to get it there.</div>
        </details>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- FINAL CTA + QUICK FORM -->
  <section class="band band-sun" id="save-my-spot">
    <div class="wrap split">
      <div class="sec-head" style="margin-bottom:0">
        <p class="eyebrow">Last call before the doors open</p>
        <h2 class="h-section">Hold my Factory Pass.</h2>
        <p class="measure muted">Take the one-minute quiz and we will match you to a tub as well. Or skip it and just hold your place with the form here.</p>
        <div class="cta-row" style="margin-top:10px">
          <a class="btn btn-gold" href="/factory-sale/quiz/">Find Your Perfect Hot Tub <span class="arrow">&rarr;</span></a>
        </div>
      </div>
      <form class="quick form" data-lead-form="quick" data-next="/factory-sale/thank-you/" novalidate>
        <p class="eyebrow">Skip the quiz, just hold my pass</p>
        <div class="field" data-req>
          <label for="q-first">First name</label>
          <input id="q-first" name="first_name" type="text" autocomplete="given-name" required>
          <span class="err">Please add your first name.</span>
        </div>
        <div class="field" data-req>
          <label for="q-phone">Phone number</label>
          <input id="q-phone" name="phone" type="tel" inputmode="tel" autocomplete="tel" placeholder="(931) 555-0123" required>
          <span class="err">Please enter a 10-digit phone number.</span>
        </div>
        <div class="field" data-req>
          <label for="q-email">Email (for the price sheet)</label>
          <input id="q-email" name="email" type="email" inputmode="email" autocomplete="email" required>
          <span class="err">Please enter a valid email.</span>
        </div>
        <label class="consent">
          <input type="checkbox" name="email_consent" id="q-consent">
          <span>Email me my Factory Pass, the sale price sheet and sale updates from Generation Hot Tubs. A team member may also call about my visit. Consent is not a condition of purchase. Unsubscribe any time. <a data-ght-href="privacyUrl" href="https://generationhottubs.com/privacy-notice/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Privacy notice</a>.</span>
        </label>
        <input type="hidden" name="source" value="sale-landing-quick-form">
        <button class="btn btn-gold btn-block" type="submit">Hold my pass</button>
        <p class="form-note">Your info stays with Generation Hot Tubs. No lists, no resale.</p>
      </form>
    </div>
  </section>
